title: Docks in the middle of the water . / old man / fisherman with boat .
content: There’s docks in the middle of the water. Almost like a square small wood platform and then a long dock that stretches out into the water (no land in site) it’s usually foggy. There was an older fisherman at the end of the dock telling ppl to get off the platform and dock and to go on his boat . The air was foggy and misty and the waves were starting to get harsh.the dock and platform were basically floating on the water. Walking on it was scary because it was moving up and down with the waves and body weight. It looked like the blue hour outside as well with how the sky looks and it just kept getting darker.
